# Glossary

```{r}
source(here::here("scripts/software.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-glossary
#| tbl-pos: H
#| tbl-cap: "Glossary."
# Keywords used in the thesis

glossary_df <- read_csv(here::here("misc/glossary.csv")) |>
  arrange(Term)

if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  kable(glossary_df,
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        escape = FALSE,
        linesep = "") |>
    kable_styling(position = "center",
                  full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 12) |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
    column_spec(1:2, width = c("3cm", "12cm"))
} else {
  kable(glossary_df,
        format = "html",
        escape = FALSE) |>
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                  position = "center",
                  font_size = 14) |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
}
```
